# METADATA.md — Hearthlight (test fixture)

Publishing language for this channel. Style and boundaries, never copy.

## Title style

Fire-led, duration-honest, cosy. Vary structure across uploads.

## Description voice

A warm, brief second-person voice. The hearth, the crackle, the hours, the use where true.

## Keyword usage

Fireplace, crackling, cosy, the season, the use.

## Tags

Six to twelve: fireplace, crackle, duration, use, season.

Two to four.

One line at most.

None required. A cabin or region only when verified.

No health or sleep guarantees. The runtime stated must be the real runtime.
